Patch Set 1:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The direction of the fix looks inverted: the image tarballs that 108a/108b restore hard-code the fsname `lustre` in CONFIGS/ and in last_rcvd, so the two helpers are the part that has to stay literal, and the `replace_nids` / `lfsck_start -M` callers are what LU-11490 should not have parameterised. Introducing a `local fsname=lustre` in test_108a()/test_108b() and using it in all six places would make that constraint explicit and keep the test working for any FSNAME.

commit.subject: LU-20642 tests: pin fsname in conf-sanity 108 helpers
commit.message:
LU-20642 tests: pin fsname in conf-sanity 108 helpers

The disk images restored by conf-sanity tests 108a/108b hard-code
the fsname "lustre" in CONFIGS/ and last_rcvd, so the whole test
must use that name regardless of $FSNAME. LU-11490 parameterized
the replace_nids and lfsck_start calls, which fail when FSNAME is
not "lustre".

Pin a local fsname in both tests and use it throughout to make the
constraint explicit.

Fixes: 134f3eced153 ("LU-11490 tests: use variable for file system name")
Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=conf-sanity env=ONLY=108,FSNAME=testfs
